topic: Data platform tool comparison and setup
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on comparing data pipeline tools, specifically reviewing Mage as an alternative to Windmill. [me] noted that while Mage has complex ETL capabilities, it is useful for creating beautiful dashboards and charts to visualize processed data and job execution statistics. The conversation also included a technical query regarding the location of ClickHouse sandbox environments, which [p1] clarified are housed in a different account.
decisions: Mage was identified as a potential tool for visualizing data pipelines and job status.
